caseName: Dixon v. 24TH Dist. Court of La.
caseNameFull: Landry DIXON v. 24TH DISTRICT COURT OF LOUISIANA

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until December 7, 2015, within which to pay docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
